E0931

`!` is used on a marker other than a structurally auto-derived trait (D-META-AUTO1=A, D-AUTODERIVE-SYNTAX1=D)

What

`!` is used on a marker other than a structurally auto-derived trait (D-META-AUTO1=A, D-AUTODERIVE-SYNTAX1=D)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0931

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0931: tests/ui/auto_derive_invalid_sign.stderr.

Error [E0931]: `!Pure` is not a signed auto-derive trait
  --> tests/ui/auto_derive_invalid_sign.jet:1:2
    |
  1 | #!Pure
    |  ^^^^^
 Why: `!` rejects compiler generation only for structurally auto-derived traits
 Fix: remove `!` from `#Pure`, or use it with an auto-derived trait
